reason: If it really is just a WhatsApp link and a PIN, no app, I'll let a creator set it up because it's free and I'm tired of giving free services with no idea if anyone comes. ₹299 is nothing next to what one free haircut or facial costs me.
objection: My girls at the front desk are busy, they will forget to type the PIN or note the code, and then the numbers are useless. And it only starts if a creator sends me the link, I'm not going to chase them.
would_change_my_mind: If after two weeks the evening message doesn't match my bill book, or my staff complain it slows the counter, I'll drop it.
